explanation: Only fires at D1, and mainly when the previous trial was rewarded after reaching S1: about 8-10 in the first ~10 trials of the episode, about 4-7 around trials 20-30, 1-3 around trials 40-50, and 0 from about trial 55 on. It is 0 at GO and D2, 0 when the reward came from S2, and only 1-3 early in the episode when the previous trial was unrewarded after S1.
